title: Celebrity watch spotted (editor picks)
why: Re-made after this morning's slot came up empty. Start with Josh Hutcherson wearing a Patek Philippe Ellipse (Robb Report, 21 Nov 2026; its readable headline/summary is enough). If he can't be pictured with rights (Getty-credited article photo via PH credited, or brand image), switch to another celebrity with a credited sighting from the last 12 months. Never stop: last resort is a WATCH EXPLAINED post.
